q1_issues.issue: "in creating the various calendars" names what the role was played in, not where the playing happened, so Location is the wrong head — the instruction set routes an about/directed-at PP to the preposition-named oblique and warns against picking the closest listed role.

(Agent sk_create_1 religion) asserts that religion created the calendars, which the text does not state — it states only that religion played a role in the creating — so it violates "assert only what the text states".

q2_gaps: support/light-verb construction with a modified event nominal ("played a very important role in V-ing", "made a significant contribution to") — the idiom rule wants one opaque symbol (which would strand the "very important" modifier) and the light-verb rule covers only occurred/happened/took place over an event noun, so neither fits

collective-only adjectives on a definite plural ("the various calendars", "assorted", "numerous") — the plural descriptive-modifier rule mandates distribution to each member, which "various" cannot bear, and the non-distributing KindProperty device is kind-level only
notes: The Degree-plus-positive pair on the role, Patient for the created calendars, the group witness for the definite plural, the untensed non-finite embedded event, and (Still sk_use_1) for "still in use" all follow the instruction set. (Member sk_group_1 various) is reported as a coverage gap rather than a defect because the distribution the rule mandates would be worse.
